svg.text: A very thin bitmap: bit s is unit s
27B defaults: 32 tokens per page → 2 MiB per unit. A 12 GiB arena is 6,144 units, so its free bits are 6,144 bits: 768 bytes.
96 words × 64 bits = 6,144 bits = 768 bytes (6 cache lines of 128 bytes)
Only a free unit has bit 1. Live, cache-only and pending all read 0: someone holds them, or the GPU may still.
unit s = bit s % 64 of word s / 64
unit 17 = 34 MiB … 36 MiB of the arena buffer
alloc: first word ≠ 0, s = 64 × word + ctz(word)
clear the bit → lowest free unit
retire: set the bit again (only after the GPU is past it)
Besides its bit, a unit has two uint16 counters (req_refs, cache_refs): 24 KiB for all 6,144. The GPU never sees any of it, only slot numbers.
